name: Tidemark — Fintech
description: An editorial fintech landing page for Tidemark, business banking for startups: ivory paper, deep forest and a single lime accent, a serif hero beside a spring-tilted metal card and a live balance, a product bento with working mini-UIs, a treasury yield calculator with an interactive chart, security guarantees, customer stories, monthly/yearly pricing with a border-beam plan, an FAQ and a disclosures footer.
designedFor: Fintech, banking, payments and treasury products
B2B SaaS that sells to finance teams and founders
Pages that need a calculator, a chart and honest disclosures beside the marketing
Seeing a count-up, a pointer-driven card and an interactive chart built as editor-controllable components
